description: Defines a controller class for a hover-enabled Unified Display Head-Up Display (HUD) in macOS, managing its visibility, hover interactions, and presentation of a SwiftUI view.

classes.name: HoverHUDController
classes.description: A final class managing the hover HUD's state, presentation, and interaction logic in macOS.

methods.name: setSuppressed
methods.description: Sets the suppression state, cancelling pending show tasks and dismissing the HUD if suppressed.

methods.name: statusItemHoverChanged
methods.description: Handles hover state changes over the menu bar item, scheduling show/dismiss tasks accordingly.

methods.name: panelHoverChanged
methods.description: Handles hover state changes over the HUD panel, scheduling its dismissal if hover exits.

methods.name: openChat
methods.description: Opens the web chat panel, dismissing the HUD.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the HUD, optionally with a reason, and handles animation and monitor cleanup.

methods.name: scheduleDismiss
methods.description: Schedules a delayed dismissal of the HUD after hover exit.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Prepares and displays the HUD window, creating it if necessary, and animating its presentation.

methods.name: ensureWindow
methods.description: Initializes the window panel and its hosting view if not already created.

methods.name: targetFrame
methods.description: Computes the target position and size for the HUD based on the anchor provider or screen bounds.

methods.name: updateWindowFrame
methods.description: Updates the window position and size, optionally animated.

methods.name: installDismissMonitor
methods.description: Sets up a global event monitor to detect outside clicks for dismissing the HUD.
